about.title: More Than Renovation
about.description: Your apartment, house, or business space is more than walls and square meters. It is your lifestyle, your comfort, your peace, and the atmosphere you return to every day. We help transform raw interiors into spaces that reflect who you are and how you want to live.

servicesPreview.title: Comprehensive Renovation and Finishing Services
servicesPreview.description: Explore the main services we provide — from surface preparation and installations to fitting, assembly, and final finishing work.

projects.title: Spaces That Speak for Themselves
projects.description: Every completed project tells a story of transformation. From modern apartments to commercial interiors, our portfolio reflects careful workmanship, functional thinking, and a commitment to creating spaces that look right, feel right, and work beautifully in everyday life.

process.title: Jak pracujemy?
process.description: Prowadzimy klienta przez każdy etap realizacji — od pierwszej rozmowy, przez wycenę i planowanie, aż po wykonanie prac oraz odbiór gotowego projektu.

consultation.title: Konsultacja
consultation.description: Skontaktuj się z nami telefonicznie lub mailowo. Odpowiemy na pytania, doradzimy najlepsze rozwiązania i umówimy dogodny termin spotkania.

estimate.title: Wycena i planowanie
estimate.description: Otrzymujemy projekt lub przyjeżdżamy na miejsce, oceniamy zakres prac i przygotowujemy wycenę oraz harmonogram realizacji.

start.title: Rozpoczęcie prac
start.description: Po zaakceptowaniu oferty podpisujemy umowę, rezerwujemy termin i organizujemy dostawę niezbędnych materiałów.

realization.title: Realizacja
realization.description: Wykonujemy wszystkie prace zgodnie z ustalonym planem, dbając o jakość, terminowość i porządek na każdym etapie.

handover.title: Odbiór i gwarancja
handover.description: Po zakończeniu prac przekazujemy gotową realizację do odbioru i zapewniamy wsparcie po zakończeniu projektu.

contact.title: Let’s Talk About Your Space
contact.description: Whether you are planning a full turnkey fit-out, a renovation, or selected finishing works, we are here to guide you. Reach out to discuss your project, ask questions, and take the first step toward a space designed around your needs.

hero.eyebrow: Pro100 Twój Remont — professional renovations and interior finishing in Warsaw

story.title: Who We Are
story.content: Pro100 Twój Remont is a team of experienced professionals who create exceptional spaces for living and working with passion, dedication, and attention to every detail. We specialise in comprehensive renovations and interior finishing, providing our clients with complete support at every stage of the project — from the initial consultation to the handover of the finished interior.

first.title: Reliability
first.text: We honour our commitments and approach every stage of the project with consistency, responsibility, and care.

second.title: Precision
second.text: We pay close attention to every detail to ensure a refined, functional, and carefully finished result.

third.title: Partnership
third.text: We build relationships based on trust, open communication, and close cooperation throughout every stage of the project.

fourth.title: Organised Execution
fourth.text: Clear processes, structured workflows, and effective coordination allow every project to progress smoothly.

fifth.title: Individual Approach
fifth.text: Every project is tailored to the client's needs, expectations, lifestyle, and vision for the space.

sixth.title: Workmanship Guarantee
sixth.text: We take responsibility for the quality of our work and stand behind the high standard of every completed project.

seventh.title: Insurance Protection
seventh.text: Our insured operations provide additional security and peace of mind throughout every stage of the renovation process.

paragraphs.first: Since 2020, we have successfully operated in the renovation and construction industry, completing projects throughout Warsaw and the surrounding areas. We work with individual clients, businesses, and public institutions. Our experience, professional technical resources, and qualified team enable us to undertake even the most demanding projects.
paragraphs.second: We believe that every renovation is more than just construction work — it is the process of creating a space that will serve people for years. That is why we approach every project individually, with complete commitment and responsibility. We combine knowledge, experience, and modern solutions to provide our clients with the highest quality of workmanship, timely completion, and a comfortable working relationship.
paragraphs.third: Every member of our team brings unique skills and experience, allowing us to continuously improve our processes and maintain the highest standards of service. We value transparent communication, precise workmanship, and attention to the appearance of every detail because we know that the smallest elements shape the final result.
paragraphs.fourth: Our mission is to create interiors that not only meet our clients' expectations but often exceed them. We carry out renovations and interior finishing for apartments, houses, commercial premises, and turnkey projects with the highest level of care, earning the trust of even the most demanding clients.

details.closing: Pro100 Twój Remont is a guarantee of professionalism, quality, and partnership — from the first meeting to the handover of the completed space.

hero.title: Comprehensive renovation and interior finishing services for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces.
hero.question: Why choose our renovation and finishing company?

paragraphs.first: Reliability and clear communication with our clients are at the core of every renovation project we undertake.
paragraphs.second: That is why we stay in constant contact throughout every stage of the process — from discussing project details and preparing estimates to carrying out the actual work — ensuring we fully understand your needs and preferences.
paragraphs.third: This approach allows us to deliver high-quality turnkey renovations while maintaining our reputation as a trustworthy and client-focused company. Our team takes pride in keeping the workspace clean, behaving professionally, and respecting the rules of residential and commercial properties.

hero.title: Our Process
hero.subtitle: A clear, organized path from first contact to finished space.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: You contact us by phone or message and tell us about your space, your needs, and your goals. This first conversation helps define the direction of the project.

design.title: Assessment & Estimate
design.description: We visit the site, assess the condition and scope of work, and prepare a cost estimate based on the real needs of the project.

proposal.title: Coordination & Agreement
proposal.description: We reserve the timeline, discuss the stages of work, confirm the details, and finalize cooperation through a clear agreement.

construction.title: Start of Works
construction.description: We organize materials, prepare the site, and begin the renovation step by step with structured execution and ongoing coordination.

walkthrough.title: Completion & Handover
walkthrough.description: We review the completed work with you, confirm the final details, and make sure the finished space meets the agreed standard.

quote.description: Tell us about your property, your goals, and the type of work you need. We will review your request, discuss the next steps, and help you move toward a well-planned renovation with clarity from the very beginning.
